observation: Twelve retained streams reproduce the same named refusal on current main: eight actual auto-compactions (164009 to 243064 pre-context tokens), three missing structured_output/StructuredOutput calls (cosine_similarity, gemm, attention_decode), and bias_gradient_reduction emitting turn 12 while the request is turn 11. All 24 Studies are artifact_optimization_only. Aggregate token accounting is not a model context window; --autocompact 1M did not prevent these observed compactions.
proposed_change: Lab/provider owns a prospective treatment: keep scientific no-compaction refusal; for artifact-only optimization, consider explicitly declaring and retaining compaction as auxiliary activity rather than claiming identical author context. This needs a successor Executor/Study and current CLI capture schema validation. Keep missing or wrong-turn terminals refused; any bounded repair invocation must be explicit, charged, same-workspace and same-candidate-custody, not synthesized success. Replay the 12 streams and validate a new bounded canary before a new sweep. Do not patch Compiler or retroactively change these run terminals.
verification_plan: A separately reviewed Lab/Executor protocol tick, retained-stream replay including scientific counterexamples, then new qualified bounded provider runs. See earlier F-2026-09-10-008/013/018 and F-2026-09-12-002; no duplicate provider runtime is proposed.
